provenance: Reviewed synthetic-only native-catalog candidate inherited byte-for-byte from frozen legacy-native-v1. Version 2 pins a source-only removal of automatic startup credential data backfill. Eight credential DDL statements and all other native source/catalog/migration checksum contracts remain unchanged. NOT a production DB baseline, operator execution permission, or runtime-admission proof.
